top_signals.title: Indian Bonds Sink on Central Bank Debt-Sale Plan, Global Selloff
top_signals.summary: Indian bonds declined after the central bank said it would sell sovereign notes to drain cash from lenders, adding to the supply of debt in a year when the market is already under pressure from record government borrowing.

top_signals.title: Japan’s 20-Year Bond Sale Demand Stronger Than 12-Month Average
top_signals.summary: Japan’s 20-year government bond auction Tuesday saw stronger demand than the 12-month average as elevated yields underpinned buying.
